title: Consideration helps release the familiar
meaning: Your gentle care can support both people through the end of a familiar form of help while leaving room for different feelings.
text: A familiar way of helping can end while tenderness remains. In the physical position of Anahata, Strength expresses care through gentle actions and restraint of pressure. Strength in energy brings a wish to accept vulnerability without suppression or hurrying someone for personal reassurance. Death in emotions offers the ending of a familiar form of involvement. You may feel both relief and sadness. Consideration allows both feelings without requiring restoration of the former arrangement or immediate delight in a new one where your help no longer seems necessary.

For example, one person has long accompanied the other to classes, and now they want to go independently. You calmly help prepare necessary belongings without turning the first separate outing into a test. **A former role can end without warm attention disappearing.** In the evening, listening to an account remains possible if sharing is wanted. The shared journey can be missed without making it compulsory proof of closeness or holding someone through sadness.

Gentleness can conceal a hope that an independent trial will fail and familiar importance return. Alternatively, an ending can prompt abrupt withdrawal of all involvement. Care then depends on preserving the former role. Warmth remains in a free response: help can answer a new request without restoring the entire old arrangement or requiring its value to be forgotten.
